svg.title: MERIDIAN logical architecture
svg.desc: Security controls deliver telemetry into a landing zone; deterministic workers normalise it to OCSF, enrich it and detect threats; the lake keeps it in Parquet under WORM retention. Alerts go to AI agents that work only through MCP servers; containment is requested and executed only after a human approves. Cases feed LODESTAR.
svg.text: SIEM-less detection, investigation and response with AI agents over MCP
read-only; no agent on the data path
2 Collection - native exports, no SIEM agents
Event Grid -> Storage Queue / S3 -> SQS
4 Ingestion workers (deterministic, auto-scaled on queue depth)
OCSF-flat Parquet; WORM (Object Lock / immutability); tiered
7 Agent layer - every tool call goes through MCP
Foundry: Claude, Azure-hosted, US Data Zone
LODESTAR: cases pushed as SOC findings (signed webhook) -> CISO Today list, KRIs (MTTD, incidents) and board reports
Ops: /healthz /readyz /metrics (Prometheus) · JSON logs · agent spend budgets · golden-set evaluation gates model changes
Security: no keys (managed identity / IAM roles), private endpoints, KMS / CMK, WORM lake, tamper-evident audit chain
